results.content: Improving students’ reading, comprehension, and reading motivation through texts generated from their prompts using ChatGPT-4: a mixed-method study. # Improving students’ reading, comprehension, and reading motivation through texts generated from their prompts using ChatGPT-4: a mixed-method study. This study aims to improve the reading, comprehension, and motivation of 4th-grade students through ChatGPT-4, which generates texts based on their own prompts. In this study, texts generated with ChatGPT-4 based on the prompts of 4th-grade students, together with related questions and visuals, are intended to enhance students’ reading, comprehension, and reading motivation. In the study examining the effects of texts created with students’ prompts using ChatGPT-4 on reading, comprehension, and reading motivation, significant differences were found in favor of the experimental groups for all variables. In this research group, the texts generated by ChatGPT based on students’ prompts enhanced their reading, comprehension, and reading motivation.
